items.quote: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
items.claim: Abraham found a ram caught in a thicket by its horns and offered it as a burnt offering in place of his son
items.mechanism: ram caught in thicket by horns
